name: s-table
description: STable monorepo for the @zchengfeng/s-table-vue data grid and documentation
author: zchengfeng <2684837849@qq.com>

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck:all && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:bundle-size && pnpm test:package && pnpm docs:build
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check packages/core/src packages/core/vite.config.ts packages/vue/src packages/vue/vite.config.ts packages/vue/benchmarks docs e2e playwright.config.ts
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @zchengfeng/s-table-core test && pnpm --filter @zchengfeng/s-table-core build && pnpm --filter @zchengfeng/s-table-vue test
scripts.test:package: pnpm exec attw --pack packages/vue --profile esm-only --entrypoints . && pnpm exec publint packages/vue && pnpm --filter @s-table/package-consumer typecheck && pnpm --filter @s-table/package-consumer build
scripts.typecheck:all: pnpm --filter @zchengfeng/s-table-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @zchengfeng/s-table-core build && pnpm --filter @zchengfeng/s-table-vue exec vue-tsc --noEmit --ignoreDeprecations 6.0 && pnpm typecheck:e2e
